about_page_title: Mayelana ne-bitcoin.rocks — Imfundo ye-Bitcoin Kusukela ngo-2022
about_page_description: i-bitcoin.rocks iyiwebhusayithi yemfundo yamahhala, evulekile, ye-Bitcoin eyasungulwa ngo-2022. Umsebenzi wethu uwukusheshisa ukwamukelwa kwe-Bitcoin ngemfundo.
about_mission_1b: ngo-2022 inomsebenzi olula: ukusheshisa ukwamukelwa kwe-Bitcoin ngemfundo.
about_mission_2: Sikhona ukuze sibe yisixhumanisi sokuqala osabelana ngaso nomuntu onothando lwe-Bitcoin. Indawo yokuqala enobungane, efinyeleleka echaza ukuthi i-Bitcoin yakha kanjani umhlaba ongcono.
about_mission_3: Abantu abaningi kakhulu abaqondi i-Bitcoin noma abakaze bathulwe ngendlela efanele kuyo. Sifuna ukushintsha lokho ngokunikeza okuqukethwe kwemfundo kwekhwalithi ephezulu kwamahhala okungaqondwa yinoma ubani.
about_what_we_do_1: Sakha okuqukethwe kwemfundo kwamahhala kwabaqalayo be-Bitcoin. Iwebhusayithi yethu ithinta izihloko ezifana nokwenyuka kwentengo, ukuzigcinela, izikhwama zemali, i-Lightning Network, nokuthi i-Bitcoin iqhathaniswa kanjani nempahla yezezimali enye nezinhlelo zokukhokha.
about_what_we_do_4: Konke okuqukethwe kwethu kuthatha ngokuthi awunalo ulwazi lwangaphambili lwe-Bitcoin. Noma ungabe umusha ku-Bitcoin noma ungum-Bitcoiner osemnkantshubomvu ofuna izinsizakalo zokwabelana, i-bitcoin.rocks ingeyakho.
about_stickers_blurb: Sithumela izitika ze-Bitcoin zamahhala emnyango wakho ukuze usize ukusabalalisa ukwazi nge-Bitcoin emphakathini wakho. Amakhulu abantu bayasikena amakhodi e-QR akulezi zitika njalo ngenyanga ukuze bafunde nge-Bitcoin.
about_card_stickers_title: Thola izitika ze-Bitcoin zamahhala zithunyelwa emnyango wakho
about_flyers_blurb: Sidizayina amaphephandaba aphrintekayo ongawanika abantu emihlanganweni, uwafake emabhodini omphakathi, noma uwafake emabhokisini ezincwadi — indlela elula yokuvusa ukufuna ukwazi futhi uthumele abantu ku-bitcoin.rocks ukuze bafunde okwengeziwe.
about_card_flyers_title: Landa futhi uphrinte amaphephandaba e-Bitcoin omphakathi wakho
about_business_blurb: Sinikeza izinsiza zebhizinisi zamahhala ezenza kube lula ukufaka abathengisi bendawo ukuze bamukele i-Bitcoin. Ikhasi lethu lebhizinisi le-Bitcoin libheka ukuthi kungani i-Bitcoin inhle ebhizinisini, indlela yokukhetha isikhwama nendawo yokukhokha, futhi linikeza izitika zamahhala ezithi 'I-Bitcoin Yamukelwa Lapha'.
about_card_business_title: Konke ibhizinisi elidinga ukuze liqale ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin
about_editorial_1: Yonke into equkethwe ku-bitcoin.rocks ikhethwe futhi ihlolwe ukuthi iqinisile. Lapho sibhekisa kudatha noma ezibalo, sicaphuna imithombo yethu ukuze uziqinisekisele ulwazi ngokwakho.
about_editorial_2: Sixhumanisa nemithombo ethembekile efana ne-Federal Reserve (FRED), i-U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, i-FDIC, iZizwe Ezihlangene, i-World Gold Council, i-Forbes, i-MIT Technology Review, u-Lyn Alden, no-James Lavish. Sikholelwa ukuthi i-Bitcoin izikhulumela yona uma amaqiniso ethulwa ngokucacile.
about_editorial_3: Okuqukethwe kwethu kubuyekezwa futhi kubuyekezwe njalo ukuqinisekisa ukunemba nobuntsha. Konke okuqukethwe kugxile kuphela emfundweni ye-Bitcoin.
about_open_source_2: i-bitcoin.rocks iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, evulekile, esebenza ngaphansi kwe-MIT License. Noma ubani angafaka isandla ku-bitcoin.rocks. Samukela ikakhulukazi abahumushi abasiza ukwenza okuqukethwe kwethu kufinyeleleke kubantu emhlabeni wonke.
about_open_source_3: Ngokubonga umphakathi wethu wabahumushi abazithandela, i-bitcoin.rocks okwamanje itholakala ngezilimi ezingu-55 futhi iyakhula.
about_contact_1: Singathanda ukuzwa kuwe. Noma unombuzo, isiphakamiso, noma ufuna nje ukuthi sawubona, thintana nathi noma nini.
